blockers: CORE_DATA_DISCLOSURE_NOT_REQUIRED: A child can select a location and tool and activate 「実施する」 without opening any 「？」 disclosure. canCommit tracks only selectedSlot and selectedTool, so reading all three locations’ 日射/風/舗装 data is not required.

THINK_AGAIN_SKIPPABLE: On the failure screen, 「先へ進む」 is enabled before reflectionPick is set. The child can bypass the reflection selection entirely, so Gate G’s required act of reconsideration is not guaranteed.
medium: TOOL_ORDER_NOT_SHUFFLED: The adopted design requires location-card and countermeasure-card display order to be independently shuffled each session, but the component renders the fixed TOOLS order directly.
low: The outcome state union includes an unused "partial" state, which obscures the actual transition model but does not affect runtime behavior.

failure_codes.finding: The commit gate requires only a selected location and tool; it does not require opening all three disclosures. The entire 日射/風/舗装 evidence set can therefore be skipped before committing.

The failure path provides reflection buttons but does not disable or gate 「先へ進む」 on reflectionPick. A player can immediately continue without making the required non-scored reconsideration. The harness only checks for reflection-related strings and does not regress this transition requirement.

TOOLS is mapped in its constant order rather than shuffled once per session, contrary to the current game_spec and no_manual_exploit_check. This does not currently correlate with the correct answer, so it is specification drift rather than an answer leak.
